title: Pantheon, Rome
summary: The Pantheon in Rome is a circular building with a granite-columned portico, topped by a concrete dome that remains the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome. A source credits Agrippa with building it in 27 BCE; it was rebuilt under Hadrian around 118–125 CE, and consecrated as a church in 609.

uncertainty.note: Start is Hadrian's rebuilding, ca. 118-125 CE (Texas Tech) or 112-125 (italia.it). Agrippa's first building (27 BC per italia.it) is not modelled. End is the present.
